content.purpose: Confirm exactly where a shell operation will read or write files.
content.mentalModel: Every shell process has a current working directory. Relative paths start there, and pwd asks the shell to print its absolute location.

tasks.instruction: Move to /var/log and record the directory reported by pwd in /home/student/answers/location.txt.
